title: English Wikipedia human pageviews per month

breaks.note: Wikimedia updated its bot detection and reclassified traffic for March to August 2025, moving automated traffic out of human (agent=user) pageviews; months before March 2025 keep the old classification. Announcement: https://diff.wikimedia.org/2025/10/17/new-user-trends-on-wikipedia/

notes: en.wikipedia, all-access, agent=user (Wikimedia's classification of human traffic; spiders and, since the 2025 reclassification, detected automated traffic are excluded). Available from July 2015. Wikimedia cautions that comparisons across the March 2025 break need care because bot detection rules changed; see https://diff.wikimedia.org/2025/10/17/new-user-trends-on-wikipedia/. Falling human pageviews may reflect AI intermediation rather than less interest in the content.
